Prerequisite - NilGeometrical Crystallography and crystal structure; Basics of
Quantum Mechanics and Statistical Mechanics; Quantum States of a Perfect 1Dimensional Crystalline Solid; Blochâs Theorem; Quantum States of a 3Dimensional Crystal; Brillouin Zone; Symmetries of Constant Energy Surface;
Dynamics of a Bloch Electron: The Crystal Momentum; Metal-InsulatorSemiconductor: Density of States in Reciprocal Space; Electrical, Magnetic,
Thermal and Optical Properties of Solid; Superconductivity; Effect of Crystal
Imperfections and Impurities on Physical Properties; Properties of Amorphous
Materials; Examples of Advanced Materials.Text Books:1.C. Kittel : Introduction
to Solid State Physics, 5th ed, Wiley Eastern Ltd, 1990. 2.B. Savopal, C.
